''See also: [[Tristania Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Tristania, known as the [[Silent One]], serves as a warrior and bodyguard to [[Naberius Clayborn]]. She was discovered by [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] as an abandoned child within a building during a [[Kameira]] rampage and was subsequently adopted by him. She possesses no family name and is approximately the same age as her employer. Tristania's combat abilities were developed through self-directed training in a [[Kanatalia]] laboratory. She is characterized by her habit of covering her entire body in bandages, which she only removes while sleeping. Her equipment includes a high-collared coat that is invested to stop bullets and a dark, explosive whip. This weapon is her [[Soulbound Vessel]], crafted from a Stormwing's [[stinger]]. In battle, she utilizes the whip to deliver concussive power and [[white light]] detonations that can destroy enemies. She is a highly alert combatant, often scanning her surroundings for threats and using her coat to shield [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Tristania is a woman sheathed from head to toe in bandages, which also cover her eyes. She wears a brown coat that is specially invested to prevent bullets from passing through.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Known as the [[Silent One]], she serves as a Chronicler and a member of the [[Guild of Witnesses]]. She is the partner of [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]], who adopted her when she was a young woman.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Tristania is the adopted daughter and partner of [[Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius]], whom she also traveled with while providing cover. She was eventually killed by him after he shot her in the head. Additionally, she shared a ship with [[Calder]] and was struck on the back by [[Shera]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|She utilizes a [[Soulbound Vessel]] in the form of a dark, explosive whip that generates lightning and pale light. This power is derived from being [[Soulbound]] to the Awakened tail of a Stormwing.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Guild of Witnesses}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Known as the [[Silent One]], Tristania is a member of the [[Guild of Witnesses]] who wears bandages over her eyes and keeps weapons concealed within her coat.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> After being self-taught in a [[Kanatalia]] laboratory, she traveled with [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]] while providing cover for him.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref> During her time on a ship with [[Calder]], she utilized a dark whip that produced lightning and pale light.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref> Tristania's combat history included using an explosive whip against the [[Children of Nakothi]], though she was also struck in the back by [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref> Despite her high and weary voice, she was eventually carried by [[Blackwatch]] members after being shot in the back of the head and killed by [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c14">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c16">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 16</ref>}}
